# URL Shortener

Create short links, redirect, and read click analytics.

## Run

```bash
./gradlew bootRun          # in-memory H2 on http://localhost:8080
```

Production: set `DATABASE_URL`, `DATABASE_USERNAME`, `DATABASE_PASSWORD`, `APP_BASE_URL`.

## API

| Method | Path | Result |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/links` `{"url": "..."}` | `201 {code, shortUrl, targetUrl}`; `400` for unsafe/invalid URLs |
| GET | `/{code}` | `302` to the target; `404` if unknown |
| GET | `/api/v1/links/{code}/stats` | `{code, totalClicks, clicksByDay[]}` (last 30 days) |

Only `http`/`https` URLs are accepted; URLs with credentials, `localhost`, private/loopback IPs and this
service's own host are rejected.
